column1: # Every vendor-portal route and the permission it is GATED by.
# Generated from lib/cvp.php, splitting on BOTH dispatch forms --
# -- because vendor/issues and vendor/issue use the second, in their own
# function (cvp_vendor_route_issues). A `case`-only split misses them AND lets
# the last case arm swallow their gates: an early run of the vendor probe
# reported `issues` as enforced at /vendor/password for precisely that reason.
# A blank second column means the route is reachable by any signed-in vendor
# user -- correct for sign-in, the dashboard, alerts, the assistant (which is
# bounded by what the user may read, not by a route gate) and one's own
# password. The whole portal is additionally behind cvp_vendor_enabled().
# Frozen so a lost gate fails test_portal_perm_enforcement.php BY ROUTE NAME.
